design.comparison: combined workflow effect of linear_hybrid versus akg_guided_hybrid, model-selected methods only
design.pairing: same block, model/profile, surface, level, target_method, payload_mode, repeat_index, fixture_id, protocol_version, policy epoch, rubric, scoring-rule hash, metrics epoch and grader mode
design.pairing_excludes: repeat identity is a pairing axis and is never a compatibility boundary; pairs are pooled across repeats for the test
design.estimand: median paired difference of final v4 components and Srun_final, linear_hybrid minus akg_guided_hybrid
design.uncertainty: bootstrap percentile 95% CI of the median paired difference, 2000 resamples, fixed seed
design.multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni within the paired metric family
design.independence: Mann-Whitney U is exploratory/supplementary only; paired coordinates do not establish independence
design.exclusions: planned, missing, failed, incomplete, unassessable, pending-review and fallback runs stay counted with reasons and are never replaced by zero
design.pooling: no pooling across block, condition, target, model, level, surface, fixture, protocol, epoch, rubric or grader
design.forced_block: not declared: this study executes only model-selected coordinates
